title: When compact latents collapse: a retained negative ARC evaluation
question: Does adding quantization, memory and a latent planner produce useful representation compression under a frozen comparison?
method: Hashed token embeddings, mean pooling, a 32-code quantizer, sparse memory and one latent action step; same input target alignment. This is not a Transformer or canonical context to distinct target prediction.
Five fixed seeds; 1,117 training and 295 validation items; gradient active parameters matched within 1%. Report arithmetic is rechecked here; no training or checkpoint replay.
lesson: Compression and collapse are different. Inspect code use, input dependence, task accuracy and positive controls together. A mechanism ablation inside a collapsed full model cannot establish a general verdict on planning or target alignment.
result: Full minus matched accuracy: -0.0115, below the declared +0.02 practical gain. The superiority gate failed. Planner and target attribution gates also failed.
Retained review describes single-code quantizer use and constant predictions. Disabling quantization restored input dependence without establishing above chance accuracy.
limits: A later trainability repair remained negative or inconclusive. The protected confirmatory test stays unopened for this failed hypothesis.
source_line: Evidence: retained matched reproduction and independent artifact audit. Scientific source 760aa7f9a73a; presentation input commit c6ee9d1dcfdf. Source links and hashes accompany this poster.
